$about: Generated by build-static-icons.mjs from icons/registry.json; do not edit by hand. Single-colour status and how-to glyphs for report images, how-to and tutorial step images, email and exports, under the registry names.

glyphs.name: system-arrow-up
glyphs.role: rise: a figure went up (black, beside the number)

glyphs.name: system-arrow-down
glyphs.role: fall: a figure went down (white, on the black pill)

glyphs.name: system-minus
glyphs.role: no change against the previous period

glyphs.name: system-trend-up
glyphs.role: an upward trend over several periods

glyphs.name: system-trend-down
glyphs.role: a downward trend over several periods

glyphs.name: system-warning-circle
glyphs.role: warning: a figure needs attention, or data is incomplete

glyphs.name: system-hourglass-high
glyphs.role: pending: data still loading or waiting on a source

glyphs.name: system-cursor-click
glyphs.role: click here: marks the control to press on a screenshot in a how-to or tutorial image

glyphs.name: system-check
glyphs.role: check this: marks a setting to confirm on a screenshot in a how-to or tutorial image

glyphs.name: system-arrow-right
glyphs.role: next: points from one step to the next in a how-to image
